title: Envelope
description:
Every ordinary structured result. `T` is the per-primitive `data` payload; errors
use [`ErrorData`]. Field order is the spec example's order.

data.description: Per-primitive payload; never contains private keys or reusable secrets.

next.description:
Machine next action, or `null` when nothing is expected of the caller.
Always emitted, `null` when absent (required-nullable in the schema:
`NextAction | null`).

operation_id.description: Present for effectful or long-running work; absent for pure reads.

schema_version.description: Major schema version of this document.

state.description: Operation state; synchronous reads report `succeeded` or `failed`.

warnings.description:
Non-fatal findings. Always emitted (listed in the schema's `required`); a
lenient reader still accepts omission as empty.

Code.description: Stable semantic code (ADR-0006 §5). Readers treat an unlisted value as an error with exit 1.

Cursor.description: Opaque, reader-scoped resumption token. Never parse it outside the runtime.

InteractionKind.description: The human step an authentication may need (ADR-0007 §7 interaction profile).

oneOf.description: No interaction (only ever `declared` for a native agent key).
Not known; never satisfies a non-interactive requirement.

NextAction.description:
Machine next action (spec §11.2 `next`, §11.6 "machine-readable next action").
`action` names are stable; parameters are present only when relevant.

action.description: Stable action name; defaults come from [`Code::default_next_action`].

cursor.description: Cursor to resume from after a resync.

decision_ref.description: Nonsecret reference to a pending owner decision.

provider_interaction.description:
The provider-owned interaction, with action `interact`, for
`PROVIDER_LOCKED` and provider-owned `INTERACTION_REQUIRED` (ADR-0007 §7).
Never combined with `decision_ref`: provider dialogs are not Heimdall
decisions (spec §5.5).

retry_after_ms.description: Suggested minimum delay before a retry.

OperationState.description: Operation states (spec §11.4). A caller timeout is not a state change.

oneOf.description: Accepted and journaled; not yet running.
Waiting for an owner or provider decision on an owner channel.
Settled: failed with a classified error.

Settled: explicitly cancelled; the result says whether an irreversible or
uncertain step may have occurred.

Unresolved: an external effect may or may not have applied. Quiescent until
reconciliation settles it to `succeeded` or `failed`; never purged while
unresolved; never retried blindly.

ProviderInteractionRef.description:
The provider-owned interaction a next action points at (spec §5.5). Used with
action `interact` for `PROVIDER_LOCKED` and provider-owned
`INTERACTION_REQUIRED`; never combined with `decision_ref`.

provider.description: The provider whose dialog it is.

ProviderKind.description: Which provider serves an agent endpoint (ADR-0007 §7 "Detection is passive").

oneOf.description: An OpenSSH-compatible agent (`ssh-agent`, the Windows OpenSSH agent service).

Not determinable passively (for example the Windows `openssh-ssh-agent` pipe,
F18).

SchemaVersion.description: A `schema_version` value as received from a peer.

Warning.description: A non-fatal finding attached to a result.

message.description: Human text; may change without breaking callers.

reason.description:
⟨M03; ADR-0008 §17.25 item 15⟩ Stable `snake_case` sub-reason refining the
code (the values are in [`m03_warning::REASONS`], with the code each refines).
Readers tolerate unknown values. Additive: omitted when absent, so every
earlier warning is byte-identical.
